description: Repository-wide inventory of oversized and forwarded parameter lists, the typed operation contexts that replaced them, and their migration status. Generated from the analyzer findings at the baseline commit and the current source; the analyzer (SME6330-SME6332, errors) prevents recurrence.

rules.SME6330: Signature above the seven-parameter ceiling (methods, constructors, delegates, local functions).
rules.SME6331: Three or more nullable delegate parameters toggling capabilities.
rules.SME6332: Parameter typed with a broad context when a narrower implemented capability interface covers every member read.

exemptions: overrides and interface implementations (signature owned by the declaration)
positional record primary constructors and deconstructors
members declaring [ParameterListContract("reason")] for an immutable external contract
